title: freeze RC12 real object publication, drift-zero, and controlled execution contract

criteria: Contract names the exact gate order from external object transport into local AIOS trust.
Contract preserves AIOS-body-only scope and excludes mirror frontend, nginx, remote signer infrastructure, object storage provisioning, remote dispatch, and production ring mutation.

Contract defines fail-closed cases for missing object URI, drift-zero, freshness, quarantine fetch, signature, revocation, compatibility, rollback, exact approval, AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine, support/recovery, audit, and authority broadening.
